text: Same staging pattern as the customers mart, new table. First declare raw_orders as a real dbt source, then write stg_jaffle_shop__orders.sql to clean it up.
Raw_orders gets declared once in sources.yml, right alongside customers — not hard-coded as a table name inside any model. That's what makes it referenceable by source() from the staging model.

The staging model reads from source, renames id to order_id and user_id to customer_id, and does nothing else. No joins, no business logic — read one source, rename columns, done. Materialize it as a view, same as the customers staging model.
That second rename matters specifically: user_id becomes customer_id so this model joins cleanly to the customers mart on a matching column name — exactly the join the next lesson writes.
Next lesson: building an intermediate model that joins this orders staging model to the customers mart you already built.
